services.name: York Beach Charters
services.desc: Enjoy a personalized striped bass fishing adventure with our expert guides. (This is designed for ages 8 and up). What to Expect: A True Maine Guide Experience Please note: This is a professional guide service, not a party charter boat. As a Registered Maine Guide, my focus is entirely on the sport of angling, local habitat conservation, and the technical pursuit of striped bass. If you are looking for a highly structured, educational day on the water to sharpen your skills, learn the fishery, and work hard for fish, you are in the right place. If you are looking for a casual booze cruise or a social drinking environment, we respectfully ask that you book with a local harbor tour instead.
